# Security Policy 🛡️

## Supported Versions

Only the latest release on the `main` branch is actively supported with security patches.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | :white_check_mark: |
| < main  | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of ThumbSwap Bot seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT open a public GitHub issue.

Instead, please report security vulnerabilities responsibly:
1. Contact the maintainer privately via GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting or email at `achakumar00@gmail.com`.
2. Provide detailed steps to reproduce the vulnerability.
3. Allow reasonable time for investigation and remediation before public disclosure.

Thank you for helping keep our software and users secure!
